verdict.rationale: There is concrete evidence of a live hosted MCP endpoint at mcp.reclaim.ai with OAuth protected-resource flow and read/write/mcp scopes, indicating agent-accessible scheduling actions exist; the AI Assistant feature also references 'MCP connectors.' However, no documentation confirms specific end-to-end operations (check availability, book, reschedule, cancel) via API/MCP, no public OpenAPI spec was found (404s on all candidate paths), and no independent/hands-on report confirms full task coverage without dashboard fallback. missing for 10: documented API/MCP method list covering book/reschedule/cancel/check-availability, a public OpenAPI reference, and independent confirmation of full non-dashboard workflows.
